english.title: In course of a building operation give rise to serious bodily injury to person in street
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the owner of

(A)_[land,]_
(B)_[a building,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY LAND OR BUILDING..) on which a building operation was carried out in or near a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..), when, in the course of that operation, there occurred an accident which

(C)_[gave rise to the risk of serious bodily injury to a person in the street]_
(D)_[would have given rise to the risk of serious bodily injury to a person in the street but for the fact that **(..SPECIFY LOCAL OR HIGHWAY AUTHORITY..) had, in the exercise of powers under an enactment, namely **(..SPECIFY ENACTMENT..), taken steps to ensure that if an accident occurred it would not have given rise to such a risk]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 168(1) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

in / near a street
an accident occurred which

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) In section 168, "building operation" means the construction, structural alteration, repair or maintenance of a building (including re-pointing, external re-decoration and external cleaning), the demolition of a building, the preparation for, and laying the foundations of, an intended building and the erection or dismantling of cranes or scaffolding.
